report_name: Chipping Norton Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan (LCWIP)
how_pct_was_used: The Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) was used to develop a cycle desire line network for Chipping Norton, identifying potential cycling demand and key corridors for improvement.
other_tools_developed: Route Selection Tool (RST) and Walking Route Assessment Tool (WRAT)
specific_evidence_of_impact: The LCWIP provides local policy backing to secure funding from central government and planning obligations from development sites, such as the 1,200-home strategic development area east of Chipping Norton. It also directly informed the update of the cycle network following public consultation and serves as a guide for future funding bids and infrastructure allocation.
pct_usage_quote: The Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) (using 2011 Census journey to work data) and local knowledge were used to create this network.
